next_measurements: Use existing envelope_decode, job_submit, embedded_queue, response_deliver, wait_response and response_copy boundaries to isolate the remaining native floor.
Compare sampled native scalar dispatch with default-off native and SDK latency separately; inclusive wait is not additive CPU.
alternatives: Inline dispatch removes a handoff but cannot preserve the existing bounded watchdog return for a wedged engine; reject without a replacement lifecycle boundary.
Reusing reply cells or preparing semantic invocations requires exact admission, owner/deadline/cancel/error equivalence and safe timeout retirement before any release.
